commands.name: suite-registered-and-green
commands.run: grep -qx 'sh claude/hooks/scratch-policy.test.sh' bin/dotfiles-tests && o="$(mktemp)" && HOME="$(mktemp -d)" sh claude/hooks/scratch-policy.test.sh > "$o" 2>&1; rc=$?; n="$(grep -c '^PASS' "$o")"; rm -f "$o"; test "$rc" -eq 0 && test "$n" -ge 87

commands.name: links-suite-and-reconcile-delivers-hook
commands.run: sh install/claude-links.test.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && d="$(mktemp -d)" && . install/common/claude-links.sh && reconcile_claude_settings_file claude/settings.json.tmpl "$d/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json,sys; h=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['hooks']; sys.exit(0 if h.get('PermissionRequest')==[{'matcher':'Bash','hooks':[{'type':'command','command':'~/.claude/hooks/scratch_policy.py'}]}] else 1)" "$d/settings.json"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $rc

commands.name: all-suites-except-public-safety-green
commands.run: bash bin/dotfiles-tests --list | grep -v public-safety | while read -r i p; do "$i" "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "FAIL $p"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: public-safety-only-expected-failure
commands.run: o="$(mktemp)"; sh git/hooks/public-safety.test.sh > "$o" 2>&1; n="$(grep -c '^FAIL' "$o")"; ok=1; if [ "$n" = 0 ]; then ok=0; elif [ "$n" = 1 ] && grep -q '^FAIL  no tracked planning artifacts$' "$o"; then ok=0; fi; rm -f "$o"; exit $ok

commands.name: claude-md-bullet

commands.name: changed-files-within-scope
commands.run: a="$(mktemp)"; w="$(mktemp)"; git diff --name-only "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)" HEAD | grep -v '^docs/' | sort > "$a"; printf '%s\n' CLAUDE.md bin/dotfiles-tests claude/contracts/td-2026-09-06-add-a-worker-side-permission-policy-hook-for-scrat-contract.json claude/hooks/scratch-policy.test.sh claude/hooks/scratch_policy.py claude/settings.json.tmpl | sort > "$w"; diff "$w" "$a"; rc=$?; rm -f "$a" "$w"; exit $rc

commands.name: added-lines-ascii-no-attribution
commands.run: b="$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)"; ! git diff "$b" HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs/' | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | LC_ALL=C grep -q '[^ -~]' && ! git diff "$b" HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs/' | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -qi 'co-authored-by\|generated with\|generated by'
